items.title: Bill Huntington Interview, 1961-12-27
items.q: sometimes Jim would go through two choruses of playing in the wrong key.

ctx.x: Yeah, yeah. George would usually say B flat concert, you know. We wouldn't say concert, say B flat meaning concert, naturally. And the band would just kick it off. Sometimes it'd just say this tune. And since the band had been, it just called the name of a tune, and since the band had been playing it for so long, they'd just kick it off in the right key. Sometimes, I remember Lawrence told me something, and I realized later on, sometimes Jim would go through two choruses of playing in the wrong key. And finally…
Didn't they call it to a melody?
